ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 300 should not register for ADV 150. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Please note: There are a specific number of seats assigned to each class level (Fresh.-Senior).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s).
